description: Merges up to sixteen separate inputs into one polyphonic cable, and will sort the channels by voltage on the way, on its own or in step with other sorting modules

params.text: Sorts the channels from low voltage to high before they are merged; the button latches and its lamp is lit while sorting is on

inputs.text: One channel of the polyphonic output; with sorting on, the voltages are reordered, so this jack's own voltage may come out on a different channel
With a cable here the sorting is done on these voltages rather than on the jacks' own, which is how several modules are kept in the same order; a channel reading exactly 0V is left where it is

outputs.text: The merged polyphonic cable; it carries as many channels as the lowest jack with a cable in it, counting from the top
Carries the voltages the sorting was done on, so another MergeSort, SplitSort or one of these chained after it sorts into the same order

notes: the channel count comes from the lowest jack with a cable in it, so a gap in the middle of the column produces channels for the empty jacks, at 0V
these can be daisy-chained, link output to link input, and the first module in the chain sets the order for all of them
this is a reimplementation of Aria Salvatrice's Smerge
